why: Both land on nearly the same reliability-not-hand-wiring hedgehog and the same stop-doing list, with Analysis 1 slightly closer to the key's quality-per-dollar and cost-competitiveness framing. Analysis 2 maps the decline path more faithfully (pay TV and the debt-funded color race in Stage 2, externalized blame in Stage 3, scattershot bets and acquisitions in Stage 4) and is slightly cleaner on figures, where Analysis 1 misstates the market return as about 10x.
